source: TIS_Global_Coverage_Rules_Complete_v1_1.md (TIS folder). Global rule set: applies to every client and form unless a documented client/form exception overrides it.
note: match = regex over the order-form coverage / liability labels. section = regex over attached-form section titles that count as a dedicated section. kw = narrative words that show the coverage was addressed in writing (used when the AI is off). writing: 'required' = if no dedicated section, the narrative must address it (GLOBAL-001); 'none' = no follow-up when the section is absent (GARAGE_COMPLETION exception).
global: GLOBAL-001 Every ordered coverage must be addressed: in a dedicated or equivalent section on any attached form, or else in writing (generally the narrative). Never invent answers.
GLOBAL-002 A section dedicated only to an unordered coverage may be recommended for omission; never a shared section another ordered coverage needs.
GLOBAL-003 Swimming Pool and Commercial Cooking sections may be omitted only when the evidence shows the exposure is absent; if uncertain, flag for verification.
GLOBAL-004 Follow instructions embedded in the form (e.g. 'General Liability - Omit if Property Only Policy'); flag conflicts for human review.
GLOBAL-005 All changes require human approval. Statuses: Recommend omission, Required / incomplete, Covered elsewhere, Uncertain / needs review.
GLOBAL-006 Rules apply to all clients and forms; classify sections by content as well as title.
GLOBAL-007 With several coverages, the union of their required subjects must be addressed.

coverages.label: BOP
coverages.scope: Property damage/protection and hazards to people.

coverages.label: Package
coverages.scope: How buildings/property can be damaged and protected; how people can be injured and protected.

coverages.label: Monoline GL
coverages.scope: Injuries to people and related liability; building conditions that can endanger occupants or visitors.

coverages.label: Monoline Property
coverages.scope: Property-damage hazards and protections. Purely personal-injury exposures (trip/fall, handrails) are outside this coverage.

coverages.label: Dwelling Exterior Only
coverages.scope: Exterior-only dwelling inspection; do not imply interior access occurred.
coverages.narrative: State that the inspection was exterior only; do not describe interiors.

coverages.label: Garage
coverages.scope: Garage operations and garagekeepers exposures: vehicle custody, key control, storage, security, theft and damage prevention.

coverages.label: Auto Physical Damage
coverages.scope: Hazards that could damage covered vehicles and protections against damage.

coverages.label: Workers' Comp
coverages.topics: employee safety, lifting practices, slips/falls, kitchen mats, ladder use, hazardous work areas, chemical and respiratory exposures, noise, ergonomics
coverages.scope: Employee safety and occupational health. Complete WC sections unless the inspector marked them N/A; summarise material findings in the narrative.

coverages.label: Sidewalk Only
coverages.scope: Sidewalk condition and pedestrian injury hazards only.

coverages.label: Rec Check
coverages.scope: Follow-up on the specified recommendations; address newly found hazards under Package standards.

coverages.label: Commercial General Liability
coverages.scope: Third-party bodily injury and property damage liability.

coverages.label: Auto Liability
coverages.topics: vehicle operations, driver safety, liability to other drivers, pedestrians and third-party property
coverages.scope: Vehicle operations and driver safety.

coverages.label: Professional Liability
coverages.topics: the professional services provided and the basic errors-and-omissions exposure
coverages.scope: Liability from professional services.

coverages.label: Products Liability
coverages.topics: products made, distributed or sold and how product exposures are controlled
coverages.scope: Liability from physical products.

coverages.label: Liquor Liability
coverages.topics: sale or service of alcohol, ID checks, server training, closing hours
coverages.scope: Liability from serving alcohol.

coverages.label: Garage/GKLL
coverages.scope: Vehicle custody, keys, security, storage, protection against damage/theft.

coverages.label: OCP
coverages.topics: the project, the hired contractor's operations, who buys the coverage and limits if available
coverages.scope: Owners and Contractors Protective liability.

coverages.label: SAM
coverages.topics: supervision of minors, background checks, abuse-prevention policies
coverages.scope: Sexual Assault and Molestation exposure, including related questions not labelled SAM.

coverages.label: Crime Coverage
coverages.topics: theft and burglary protection, cash handling, employee dishonesty controls
coverages.scope: Theft, burglary, employee dishonesty and financial crime.

coverages.label: Inland/Ocean Marine Coverage
coverages.topics: the movable property, how it is moved and handled, and how it is protected in transit and storage
coverages.scope: Movable goods and property in transit or storage.

coverages.label: Stock Throughput Coverage
coverages.topics: transport, handling, storage and protection of goods, and processing hazards to inventory on site
coverages.scope: Goods across the supply chain.
